cause: ESR WnR was interpreted as a store even when CM marked cache maintenance. ART flushes a lazy RX code alias before its first execution.
checks: cold RX alias cache synchronization and execution return 42
real store to RX raises SIGSEGV/SEGV_ACCERR at the expected address
cache maintenance on PROT_NONE raises SIGSEGV/SEGV_ACCERR
restoring RX permits cache synchronization and execution
before_note: The pre-fix run used the same cold-alias operation; protection rejection checks subsequently gained an explicit SIGSEGV handler because Bionic terminates its default fatal handler with exit(1).
